description: [WRITE] Enable one or more built-in variables in a GTM workspace. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

types.description: Array of built-in variable types to enable. Known types include: pageUrl, pageHostname, pagePath, referrer, event, clickElement, clickClasses, clickId, clickTarget, clickUrl, and more.

name: built_in_variables_enable
